Title: IAgentInstancesContainer - In-Flight Agent Registry
Summary: Contract for the in-flight agent instance registry. Tracks running AgentInstance runs so the scheduler can avoid duplicate spawns and discover completed instances to tear down.
Content:
# IAgentInstancesContainer

**Namespace**: `Cyrena.Desk.Contracts`
**Assembly**: `Cyrena.Desk.Core`

## Purpose
Registry of in-flight `AgentInstance` runs. The scheduler uses it to (a) avoid
spawning a second instance of the same agent while one is already running, and
(b) discover completed instances to tear down and recompute the next execution.

## Members

```csharp
public interface IAgentInstancesContainer
{
    bool TryAdd(AgentInstance instance);
    bool TryRemove(string id, out AgentInstance? instance);
    bool IsActive(string id);
    bool TryGet(string id, out AgentInstance? instance);
    IEnumerable<AgentInstance> Instances { get; }
}
```

### TryAdd
Adds an `AgentInstance` keyed by `instance.ScheduledAgent.Id`. Returns `false`
if an instance for the same id already exists.

### TryRemove
Removes the instance for the given id. Returns `true` and outputs the removed
instance if present; otherwise returns `false` and outputs `null`.

### IsActive
Returns `true` if an instance for the given id is currently registered.

### TryGet
Returns the instance for the given id if present, otherwise `null`.

### Instances
Live collection of all registered instances. The scheduler snapshots this before
iterating to avoid mutating-during-iteration.

## Implementation
`Cyrena.Desk.Services.AgentInstancesContainer` in `Cyrena.Desk.Extension`
(internal, registered as singleton via `DeskExtension.BuildExtension`).
Backed by `ConcurrentDictionary<string, AgentInstance>`.
